name: citygml
label: OGC CityGML 3.0
description: 3D city model standard — buildings, bridges, roads for digital twins and smart cities

table_notes.cgml_city_model: Root container for a CityGML dataset; all feature tables reference this via city_model_id to partition multi-city or multi-version deployments.
table_notes.cgml_building: Central feature table for above- and below-ground structures; holds footprint geometry, height, floor counts, and JSONB fields for 3D solids and structured address data.
table_notes.cgml_bridge: Models road, rail, and pedestrian bridges as linear features with construction metadata; geometry stored as a WGS84 linestring along the bridge centreline.
table_notes.cgml_transportation: Road, railway, and path segments with surface and functional classification; geometry is a WGS84 linestring suitable for network routing.
table_notes.cgml_land_use: Polygon parcels describing how land is zoned or used (residential, commercial, agricultural, etc.); function is JSONB to support multi-coded parcels.

cgml_city_model.name: id
cgml_city_model.description: Primary key — unique identifier for this city model instance

cgml_city_model.name: name
cgml_city_model.description: Human-readable name for the city model (e.g. 'Helsinki 3D+ 2024')

cgml_city_model.name: description
cgml_city_model.description: Free-text description of the model's scope, data sources, and coverage

cgml_city_model.name: creation_date
cgml_city_model.description: Date the model dataset was created or published

cgml_city_model.name: bounding_box
cgml_city_model.description: WGS84 polygon enclosing the full spatial extent of this city model

cgml_city_model.name: reference_system
cgml_city_model.description: Coordinate reference system identifier (e.g. EPSG:25832) used by source data

cgml_building.name: id
cgml_building.description: Primary key — unique identifier for this building record

cgml_building.name: city_model_id
cgml_building.description: References cgml_city_model.id — the parent dataset this building belongs to

cgml_building.name: gml_id
cgml_building.description: Globally unique GML identifier from the source CityGML file (e.g. BLDG_0001)

cgml_building.name: name
cgml_building.description: Common name or address label for the building (may be NULL for unnamed structures)

cgml_building.name: func_code
cgml_building.description: JSONB array of CityGML building function codes (e.g. [{"code":"1000","label":"residential"}])

cgml_building.name: usage
cgml_building.description: JSONB array of actual usage codes; may differ from function for mixed-use buildings

cgml_building.name: year_of_construction
cgml_building.description: 4-digit year the building was constructed (NULL if unknown)

cgml_building.name: year_of_demolition
cgml_building.description: 4-digit year the building was demolished; NULL means still standing

cgml_building.name: roof_type
cgml_building.description: Roof form classification (e.g. flat, gabled, hipped, mansard) per CityGML codelist

cgml_building.name: storeys_above_ground
cgml_building.description: Number of floors above ground level (excludes basement)

cgml_building.name: storeys_below_ground
cgml_building.description: Number of underground floors (basement / parking levels)

cgml_building.name: measured_height_m
cgml_building.description: Measured building height in metres from ground to highest roof point

cgml_building.name: footprint
cgml_building.description: WGS84 polygon of the building footprint at ground level; used for 2D spatial queries

cgml_building.name: lod1_solid
cgml_building.description: JSONB encoding of the LoD1 block-extrusion solid geometry (GeoJSON or CityJSON surface array)

cgml_building.name: address
cgml_building.description: JSONB structured address: {"street","number","city","postcode","country"} per CityGML xAL subset

cgml_bridge.name: id
cgml_bridge.description: Primary key — unique identifier for this bridge record

cgml_bridge.name: city_model_id
cgml_bridge.description: References cgml_city_model.id — the parent dataset this bridge belongs to

cgml_bridge.name: gml_id
cgml_bridge.description: Globally unique GML identifier from the source CityGML file

cgml_bridge.name: name
cgml_bridge.description: Official or common name of the bridge (e.g. 'Tower Bridge')

cgml_bridge.name: func_code
cgml_bridge.description: JSONB array of bridge function codes (e.g. road bridge, railway bridge, pedestrian)

cgml_bridge.name: year_of_construction
cgml_bridge.description: 4-digit year the bridge was constructed (NULL if unknown)

cgml_bridge.name: span_m
cgml_bridge.description: Total span of the bridge in metres (longest single span for multi-span bridges)

cgml_bridge.name: geometry
cgml_bridge.description: WGS84 linestring tracing the bridge centreline from abutment to abutment

cgml_transportation.name: id
cgml_transportation.description: Primary key — unique identifier for this transportation segment

cgml_transportation.name: city_model_id
cgml_transportation.description: References cgml_city_model.id — the parent dataset this segment belongs to

cgml_transportation.name: gml_id
cgml_transportation.description: Globally unique GML identifier from the source CityGML file

cgml_transportation.name: type
cgml_transportation.description: CityGML transportation type: Road, Railway, Square, Track, Waterway, or Path

cgml_transportation.name: func_code
cgml_transportation.description: Functional classification (e.g. motorway, residential, cycleway) per CityGML codelist

cgml_transportation.name: surface_material
cgml_transportation.description: Pavement or surface material (e.g. asphalt, concrete, cobblestone, gravel)

cgml_transportation.name: geometry
cgml_transportation.description: WGS84 linestring representing the segment centreline for routing and display

cgml_land_use.name: id
cgml_land_use.description: Primary key — unique identifier for this land use parcel

cgml_land_use.name: city_model_id
cgml_land_use.description: References cgml_city_model.id — the parent dataset this parcel belongs to

cgml_land_use.name: gml_id
cgml_land_use.description: Globally unique GML identifier from the source CityGML file

cgml_land_use.name: class
cgml_land_use.description: Top-level land use class per CityGML codelist (e.g. residential, industrial, agriculture)

cgml_land_use.name: func_code
cgml_land_use.description: JSONB array of detailed function codes; multiple entries for mixed-use parcels

cgml_land_use.name: geometry
cgml_land_use.description: WGS84 polygon boundary of the land use parcel

short_description: 3D city model standard — buildings, bridges, roads for digital twins and smart cities
long_description: OGC CityGML 3.0 is the international standard for 3D city models, covering buildings, bridges, roads, vegetation, and land use with multi-level-of-detail (LoD) geometry. The schema captures 2D footprints and building attributes suitable for most smart city analytics, with JSONB fields for 3D geometry when needed.
when_to_use: Use for digital twin platforms, smart city dashboards, urban planning tools, or any application modeling the built environment. Used by Singapore's Virtual Singapore, Helsinki 3D+, and many EU city digital twins. Required for EU Urban Digital Twin projects and some EU Cohesion Fund applications. Pairs with PostGIS for spatial queries.
